hero.subline: ASTRO is the student rocketry association at HVL in Bergen. We design, build, test and launch rockets — the whole cycle, in our own hands.

highlights.heading: From drawing board to launch rail
highlights.lead: Everything we fly is built by students. We design the structure, burn the motors, write the code and head into the field to test — over and over until it flies.

build.title: Structure and propulsion
build.body: Airframes are machined, laminated and assembled in the workshop at HVL. Motors are static-fired on the ground long before anything is cleared to fly.
build.alt: ASTRO students working on the rocket airframe in the workshop

avionics.title: Avionics and electronics
avionics.body: We develop our own flight computer — sensors, logging, telemetry and parachute deployment. Soldered, programmed and tested entirely in-house.
avionics.alt: Close-up of ASTRO's in-house flight computer and electronics

footer.tagline: The student rocketry association at Western Norway University of Applied Sciences.
